svg.title: Jiteesh Ghodke: software engineer, system design, competitive programming
svg.desc: Chapter one, boot. An arcade title screen powers on: a striped neon sun rises over a scrolling city, the name Jiteesh Ghodke drops in letter by letter, and Bit the robot walks in to say the arcade is open all night.
